rules.title: Diabetes diagnosis required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: The beneficiary must have diabetes mellitus for therapeutic CGM coverage.
rules.source_sentence: 1. The beneficiary has diabetes mellitus (Refer to the ICD-10 code list in the LCD-related Policy Article for applicable diagnoses); and,

rules.title: Frequent BGM testing required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: The beneficiary must have been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing.
rules.source_sentence: 2. The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,

rules.title: Insulin-treated with multiple daily injections or Medicare-covered CSII pump required for CGM coverage
rules.summary: The beneficiary must be insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump.
rules.source_sentence: 3. The beneficiary is insulin-treated with multiple (three or more) daily injections of insulin or a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump; and,

rules.title: Insulin regimen requires frequent adjustment for CGM coverage
rules.summary: The beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen must require frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results.
rules.source_sentence: 4. The beneficiary's insulin treatment regimen requires frequent adjustment by the beneficiary on the basis of BGM or CGM testing results; and,

rules.title: In-person visit within 6 months prior to ordering CGM required
rules.summary: Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner must have an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met.
rules.source_sentence: 5. Within six (6) months prior to ordering the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to evaluate their diabetes control and determined that criteria (1-4) above are met; and,

rules.title: Follow-up in-person visit every 6 months required for continued CGM coverage
rules.summary: Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner must have an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.
rules.source_sentence: 6. Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan.

rules.title: Only one unit of K0553 may be billed per 30 days
rules.summary: Only one (1) UOS of code K0553 may be billed to the DME MACs at a time. Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.
rules.source_sentence: Only one (1) UOS of code K0553 may be billed to the DME MACs at a time. Billing more than 1 UOS per 30 days of code K0553 will be denied as not reasonable and necessary.
